claims.claim: A strong neatly used kids bicycle
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows visible dirt/rust spotting and paint wear, inconsistent with 'neatly used'.
No receipt, date-stamped photo, or packaging shown to confirm purchase age.
Witness report explicitly lists brake/gear condition as not shown.
Photo 0 shows rust spotting on the frame.
No close-up of components, serial numbers, or brand markings to confirm originality.

risks.risk: Extent of rust/corrosion beyond visible spotting, possibly affecting structural parts or chain
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints, fork, and chain/underside
risks.if_unproven: price as having moderate surface rust needing treatment

risks.risk: Brake and gear functionality not demonstrated
risks.proof: Short video showing braking response and gear shifting under load

risks.risk: Tire tread wear and pressure condition unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of tread pattern on both tires
risks.if_unproven: price as worn tires requiring replacement

risks.risk: Missing front basket despite mount being present
risks.proof: Confirm via photo whether basket is included in sale

risks.risk: Hidden frame damage or dents not visible from the single side angle
risks.proof: Additional photos from front, rear, and top-down angles
risks.if_unproven: price based only on visible side, assuming no hidden damage credit

risks.risk: Actual age of bicycle may exceed claimed 6 months, affecting wear expectations
risks.proof: Purchase receipt or original box/photo with timestamp
risks.if_unproven: price as standard used condition, not near-new

proof_requests: Close-up photos of rust/corrosion areas on frame and chain
Video demonstrating brake and gear operation
Close-up photos of both tire treads
Additional angle photos (front, rear, top) of the bicycle
Any proof of purchase date or original packaging
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a children's bicycle, but seller claims of 'no rust' and 'neatly used' are contradicted by visible rust and wear, and mechanical condition is unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
